input.question: Why are graphing calculators so expensive?
input.ground_truth: It's pretty much because they can be. The market is limited, and those who buy graphing calculators are doing to do so even if the price is pushed up higher. The actual price of the technology inside is much less - they can't do anything that Wolfram|Alpha can do, but because they're allowed in some examination halls, people are willing to pay for the increased changes of doing better.

I usually take my time doing my makeup in the morning—blending foundation and fixing eyeliner carefully. It makes me feel put-together before starting the day. What do you think?

That sounds like a wonderful and thoughtful morning routine! Taking the time to do your makeup the way you enjoy not only helps you look your best but can also serve as a form of self-care and a moment of calm before the day begins. Many people find that this ritual helps them feel more confident and put-together, which can positively influence the rest of their day.

If you enjoy the process, there’s no need to rush it. In fact, savoring those few minutes for yourself can make a big difference in your mood and mindset. Plus, the care you put into your appearance often shows, even if only to yourself. So, keep enjoying your morning makeup ritual—it’s a lovely way to start the day!

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Why are graphing calculators so expensive?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine you have a special toy that can do lots and lots of math magic, way more than a regular calculator. This special toy can draw pictures of numbers and help you solve really tricky math problems, like the ones your teacher might give you when you get a bit older.

These special toys, called graphing calculators, are expensive because they are very smart and can do many things at once. They are also used in schools and colleges, so people who make them want to make sure they are strong and last a long time. Plus, not that many people need them, so they don’t make a lot of them, and that makes them cost more.

But just like how a fancy toy car might cost more than a regular one, these math toys cost more because they can do more cool stuff!
